items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: Keg had been playing up with Eli Rice and Grant Moore out of Milwaukee

ctx.x: Well Keg wasn't with the Blue Devils then, was he?

No, no. No. See, Keg had been playing up with Eli Rice and Grant Moore out of Milwaukee, and you know, and him and Joe Thomas, trumpet player, Eddie Thompkins, they all played with Eli Rice after they left Jesse Stone, see?

So in walks this guy Lester Young, blowing, and he had -- he was at that time playing two different styles. I feel always felt that Lester was inspired by Frankie Trumbauer. Well he used to play alto, you know. And his style was mixed. At one time he would play a type of Frankie Trumbauer…
